robot: JAXV3_Assembly (URDF_1109 task URDF, robot_v3/). Joint values use the document sign convention: only shoulder_roll_to_shoulder_yaw is the negative of the original URDF_1109 value (README 5.1)
network: obs (45) -> (obs - mean) / (std + 0.01) -> Linear 256 -> ELU -> Linear 256 -> ELU -> Linear 11
obs_notes: 45 inputs (README 8.1). 0-13 = the joint TARGETS sent to the motors (not encoder readings), normalized with the V2 limits; 14-27 = (target - previous step target) / dt x 0.2; 9 and 23 (RotationBody) fixed at -0.7222 and 0; 28-42 as grasp_lift_23025 (cube position from the observation reference point (0, 0, 0.3575), 29 minus 0.115, 30 minus dz = -0.0575, pad ADC readings); 43-44 = sin(4 psi), cos(4 psi)
trained_with: motor torque limits (AK45 8 N*m on Isaac 0-3, 3.92 / 1.96 / 0.92 on 4 / 5 / 6, MG90S 0.177 on RotationBody and the six finger joints), finger-link and cube friction 2.0 (rest of the robot 0.4), squeeze S = 1.2 + 0.8 a N, servo-emulated arm, L-return with action 7 held at +1 (README 5.3, 7.5, 7.7, 10); fine-tuned from 25300 (v78b/v78d rounds: harsh episodes 50 %, cube 30-60 g, lr 1e-5) - same inputs, outputs and rules as 25300
action_post: clip each of the 11 outputs to [-1, 1], then the env's low-pass filter a = 0.25 * new + 0.75 * previous
export_check: TorchScript max |diff| 0 vs the checkpoint actor; ONNX max |diff| 1.2e-4 vs TorchScript (onnx reference evaluator, float32 rounding)
deploy_notes: 2026-11-11: chain rule change, not a training change - the reach-in ends 0.5 cm lower than the pre-grasp grid pose (table-height blend e = table offset - 0.005, floored at -0.01; README 7.3) so finger 1 (the top finger) touches the cube; the L return goes to the same q_L for every cube (README 7.7)
